capabilities: Count typing bursts and corrections per minute
Log daily stats totals for characters added and deleted
Store stat history locally across days
Analyze trends in speed and error rate
disambiguation: Not a typing trainer like Monkeytype; it only records passive stats during normal note-taking, with no target text or leaderboard.
extras: Correction detection is explicitly an estimate; the author says a better error-inference method is a future goal. Stats are stored in the plugin's data.json on the local machine only.
problem: Obsidian gives no feedback on typing speed or error habits, so improvement requires separate typing-test sites disconnected from real note-taking.

relations.evidence: This plugin does not work like typing websites such as keybr or Monkeytype
This plugin does not work like typing websites such as keybr or Monkeytype

summary: Passive typing tracker that compiles statistics like WPM, bursts, and corrections in the background while you take notes.
